title: Commercial Premises, Safety & Regulatory Permits
description: The sequential compliance roadmap to license commercial operations, factories, hospitality, and office spaces in Ghana—securing environmental, fire, data protection, and municipal operating clearances.

steps.title: Obtain Environmental Permit from EPA
steps.why: The Environmental Protection Act 1994 (Act 490) mandates that commercial, industrial, agricultural, or hospitality undertakings obtain an Environmental Permit (EIA or EMP) before physical operations commence.
steps.do_this_when: Before constructing or commissioning commercial premises.

options.label: Environmental Protection Agency Client Portal
options.notes: Online registration portal for environmental permits, schedules, and assessment forms.

steps.title: Acquire Fire Certificate from GNFS
steps.why: Fire Precaution Regulations (L.I. 1724) mandate that all commercial buildings, factories, warehouses, and offices pass safety inspections and hold a valid Ghana National Fire Service Fire Certificate.
steps.do_this_when: Upon fitting out premises and installing certified fire extinguishers, alarms, and emergency exits.

options.label: Ghana National Fire Service Fire Certificate Desk
options.notes: Official inspection guidelines and requirements for obtaining commercial fire certificates.

steps.title: Facility Hygiene & Premises Licensing (FDA)
steps.why: Under the Public Health Act 2012 (Act 851), facilities processing, packaging, storing, or serving food, beverages, cosmetics, pharmaceuticals, or medical devices must pass Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) audit.
steps.do_this_when: If manufacturing, handling, or retailing consumables, cosmetics, or medicines.

options.label: FDA Facility Licensing and Premises Registration
options.notes: Premises licensing requirements, inspection protocols, and application guidelines.

steps.title: Product Certification & Standards Mark (GSA)
steps.why: Manufactured goods intended for commercial distribution or export in Ghana must be certified for quality compliance under the Standards Authority Act.
steps.do_this_when: When manufacturing products for commercial retail.

options.label: Ghana Standards Authority Product Certification
options.notes: Application and audit for national certification and quality mark issuance.

steps.title: Register as Data Controller with DPC
steps.why: The Data Protection Act 2012 (Act 843) makes it mandatory for any commercial entity collecting customer, employee, or partner personal data to be registered with the Data Protection Commission.
steps.do_this_when: Prior to processing customer, client, or employee data.

options.label: Data Protection Commission Registration Portal
options.notes: Official portal for data controllers and data processors in Ghana.

steps.title: Obtain Municipal Business Operating Permit (BOP)
steps.why: Metropolitan, Municipal, and District Assemblies (MMDAs) require annual operating permits to authorize commercial business activities at your physical address.
steps.do_this_when: Upon acquiring your tenancy/lease and before opening doors to the public.

options.label: Accra Metropolitan Assembly BOP Guidelines
options.notes: Official MMDA rate schedules and annual operating permit guidelines.

steps.title: National Communications Authority (NCA) Authorisation
steps.why: Enterprises operating radio communications, VSAT networks, broadcasting, or importing telecom transmission equipment require NCA type approval and spectrum licenses.
steps.do_this_when: When installing broadcast equipment, commercial radio links, or telecom infrastructure.

options.label: National Communications Authority Online Portal
options.notes: Telecommunications authorisations, broadcasting licenses, and hardware type approval.

steps.title: Aviation & Maritime Commercial Operations (GCAA & GMA)
steps.why: Commercial aircraft, drone operators, shipping vessels, and boat transport operators require statutory inspection and operator clearance from GCAA or the Ghana Maritime Authority.
steps.do_this_when: When establishing aviation operations, commercial drone flights, or marine vessel services.

options.label: Ghana Civil Aviation Authority Applications
options.notes: Pilot, commercial aircraft, and air operator licensing guidelines.

options.label: Ghana Maritime Authority Vessel Registration & Certification
options.notes: Vessel registration, inland watercraft permits, and seafarer certification.
